verdict.rationale: E2B documents lifecycle-event webhooks that send notifications to an external web server. That is an outbound callback primitive, not a product-level way to define rules that trigger actions. Any rule logic or resulting action would have to be built by the user on their own server, so this is an adjacent developer building block and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
